rulebook.note: Citations are rulebook-relative (oaa/... and docs/...). discrepancies.summary: 0x800A is named MEDIA_MESSAGE_UPDATE_UI_CONFIG_REPLY with a separate UpdateUiConfigReply message in the pinned AASDK schema (implying a reply), but OAA wire truth (gold handler evidence) is that 0x8009/0x800A are the two directions of ONE UpdateUiConfigRequest and 'No reply is implied'; the real HU->Phone reply is 0x8012.
discrepancies.resolution: When tasks 28-33 implement UI config: consume/emit 0x8009/0x800A as request semantics (bidirectional), reply only via 0x8012. If schema backing is needed, it is an explicitly reviewed provenance patch (PROPOSED, not implemented here).

discrepancies.summary: 0x8012 UpdateHuUiConfigResponse (HU->Phone, ThemingTokensStatus) is absent from the pinned AASDK MediaMessageId enum (ends at 32779 = 0x800B) and from our adapter; without it the theming-token exchange (0x8011 -> 0x8012) cannot be answered.
discrepancies.resolution: Fixture F-L pins the bytes; implementation either at the project-owned boundary (message id + body codec, no schema overlay) or via reviewed provenance patch. Not implemented here.

discrepancies.summary: UI-config payload at the same tag: AASDK UiConfig{1-3 Insets, 4 UiTheme} vs OAA AdditionalVideoConfig{1-3 VideoInsets, 4 UITheme, 5-8 GAL 4.3+ hidden_ui_elements/resize_actions/margin_configs/blended_ui_config}. Tags 1-4 wire-compatible; 5-8 are extensions the pinned schema cannot represent.
discrepancies.resolution: Extension-tolerance policy (see deliverable 3) must treat AdditionalVideoConfig f5-8 as tolerated extensions, not malformed. GAL fields stay OFF for emission.

discrepancies.summary: 0x8003 body f1 enum conflict: AASDK Config.Status WAIT=1/READY=2 vs OAA AVChannelSetupStatus NONE=0/FAIL=1/OK=2 (default FAIL; 0 invalid). Value 1 means WAIT to AASDK and FAIL to OAA.
discrepancies.resolution: When implementing task 28 setup: emit status=2 only (OK/READY agree); never emit 1; treat received 0 as invalid. Contested fixture F-O2 pins the ambiguous bytes.

discrepancies.summary: VideoFocusReason enum gap: AASDK has 0/1/2 only; OAA adds 3=LAST_MODE and 4=USER_SELECTION (real modern-phone values). Proto2 optional-enum parse silently defaults missing values to 0 (UNKNOWN) - a misread, not a rejection.
discrepancies.resolution: The tolerance-policy classifier (deliverable 3) must classify this as unknown-enum-on-known-tag and reject/flag, never silently default. Enum widening is a schema provenance patch (PROPOSED).

discrepancies.summary: 0x8007 field 1: AASDK VideoFocusRequestNotification keeps deprecated disp_channel_id=1; OAA canonical VideoFocusRequest has no field 1.
discrepancies.resolution: Decode must ignore-or-flag field 1 presence; never route on it.

discrepancies.summary: 0x800B AudioUnderflow: 17.3 endpoint receives NO PAYLOAD; AASDK defines AudioUnderflowNotification{session_id=1 required}. Emitting/expecting a body diverges from wire truth.
discrepancies.resolution: Emit empty body when implemented.

discrepancies.summary: ServiceDiscoveryRequest f4/f5 semantic shift: AASDK label_text=4/device_name=5 vs OAA (live capture) device_name=4/device_brand=5.
discrepancies.resolution: When decoding the phone's discovery request, read device_name from tag 4 (OAA live-capture truth); tag 5 = device brand/model string.

discrepancies.summary: ServiceDiscoveryResponse f16: AASDK defines ConnectionConfiguration=16; OAA retracted that mapping (2026-07) - no field 16 in 16.1, the class family is GoogleAuth. Sending f16 emits retracted/foreign semantics.
discrepancies.resolution: Do not emit f16; decode should treat it as an extension field (tolerate/ignore) pending evidence.

discrepancies.summary: Status enum: OAA adds CAR_PROPERTY_SET_FAILED=-26 and CAR_PROPERTY_LISTENER_FAILED=-27; AASDK MessageStatus lacks them. Phone responses carrying these fail proto2 required-enum checks as malformed instead of typed handling.
discrepancies.resolution: Car-control era (tasks 35+); until then fail-closed rejection is acceptable. Enum widening = provenance patch (PROPOSED).

discrepancies.summary: AudioType value names: 1 = GUIDANCE (AASDK) vs SPEECH (OAA, unverified); 4 = TELEPHONY (AASDK) vs ALARM (OAA, unverified). Wire values align; the semantic reading of what audio the phone routes on a channel we advertise with 1 or 4 is contested.
discrepancies.resolution: Galaxy probe question (action item 6): observe which stream the phone sends on the channel advertised with audio_type=1/4. Our guidance_audio/speech_audio naming stays; flag only.

discrepancies.summary: Static ChannelId ordinals are fork-drifted: pinned opencardev aasdk (1=SENSOR, 2=MEDIA_SINK, 7=TELEPHONY, 8=INPUT, 9=MIC, 10=BT, 11=RADIO, 12=NAV, 13=MEDIA_PLAYBACK, 14=PHONE, 15=BROWSER, 16=VENDOR, 17=GENERIC_NOTIF, 18=WIFI) vs OAA GAL types / f1xpl aasdk (1=INPUT, 7=SENSOR, 8=AV_INPUT, 9=BT, 10=NAV, 11=MEDIA_INFO, 13=PHONE, 15=RADIO, 17=WIFI, 19-22 later additions). The wire frame byte is the DYNAMIC Service.id in both models.
discrepancies.resolution: No wire impact under the dynamic-id routing rule (accepted task 15-18 behavior). Keep ordinals as reference-only; the ChannelAdapter.cpp:2 comment calling ID space 1 'the per-frame channel byte' contradicts Messages.hpp and should be corrected in a follow-up (PROPOSED).

discrepancies.summary: Control 0x000E: ours/AASDK name it NavFocusNotification with REQUIRED focus_type; OAA names it NavigationFocusResponse with OPTIONAL type (HU->Phone response to 0x000D). A field-less message is legal per OAA, malformed per AASDK.
discrepancies.resolution: Implement 0x000D/0x000E codecs with OAA optionality (tolerate absent f1) and response semantics.

discrepancies.summary: ControlMessageId::unexpected_message=255 and framing_error=65535 are AASDK-internal error sentinels, not wire IDs (absent from OAA ControlMessageIdsEnum), yet Messages.hpp:33-34 declares all enum values 'the wire contract'.
discrepancies.resolution: Comment/contract clarification (accepted-file edit deferred); no codec may ever emit 255/65535. Fixture tests assert decode rejects unknown discriminators.

discrepancies.summary: VersionResponse length is version-conditional: 8 bytes (id+major+minor+status) for v<1.6, plus an appended WireConfig blob for requests >= v1.6. A strict 8-byte parser would misframe modern phone responses.
ours: src/protocol/aasdk_adapter/ControlAdapter.cpp:63-89 (request codec is strict 4-byte body; response codec absent)
discrepancies.resolution: When implementing the response codec (task 28): parse the 8-byte prefix, tolerate/retain a trailing WireConfig tail as extension data.

discrepancies.summary: Handshake sequencing: OAA interactions/03 states the HU sends ServiceDiscoveryResponse FIRST (proactive advertisement) and the phone replies with ServiceDiscoveryRequest ('Despite the names...'). aasdk runtime and accepted task-17/18 behavior implement request->response. The message BYTES agree; the ORDER does not.
discrepancies.resolution: Galaxy probe question #1 (action item 6). Do NOT change session sequencing before phone evidence; do NOT let tasks 28-33 hard-code the order as baseline.

discrepancies.summary: ChannelOpenRequest direction: OAA canonical proto says Phone->HU (APK sender class cited) while OAA interactions/04 and channel-map say HU->Phone and 'the HU opens channels'. Anchored Phone->HU (proto evidence + aasdk handleChannelOpenRequest + accepted behavior).
discrepancies.resolution: Galaxy probe question #2; record who sends 0x0007 in the first session.

discrepancies.summary: channel-map.md:43-45 control-message table inverts SDP directions and attaches wrong content descriptions vs the schemas and interactions/03 (calls the response 'Phone's available channels' though it carries head-unit identity). OAA-internal doc defect.
discrepancies.resolution: Cite schemas + interactions/03 (+ live-capture field notes), not the channel-map control table.

discrepancies.summary: 02-version-ssl-auth.md:74 annotates the version frame flags as 0x00 = 'BULK frame, MessageType CONTROL, PLAINTEXT'; the flags table (architecture.md:81-97) and pinned aasdk FrameType/MessageType say that combination is 0x07 (0x00 = MIDDLE+SPECIFIC+PLAIN). OAA-internal doc defect.
discrepancies.resolution: Ours matches the architecture table and aasdk; fixtures pin flags=0x07 for control-bulk.

discrepancies.summary: 0x8007/0x8008 directions: interactions/04 AV table swaps them vs the gold proto comments and the 17.3 endpoint ledger (which is ranked higher: 'Direct 17.3 endpoint evidence outranks the historical enum labels').
discrepancies.resolution: Anchor = 17.3 ledger: 0x8007 Phone->HU, 0x8008 HU->Phone (also matches aasdk send/handle split).

discrepancies.summary: 0x0012/0x0013: ours/AASDK name 19 audio_focus_notification; OAA names 0x0012/0x0013 AUDIO_FOCUS_REQUEST/RESPONSE. Wire ids agree.
discrepancies.resolution: Naming only; implement as request/response semantics.

discrepancies.summary: 0x0011: ours voice_session_notification vs OAA VOICE_SESSION_REQUEST. Wire id agrees.
discrepancies.resolution: Naming only.

discrepancies.summary: 0x000F/0x0010: ours byebye_request/response vs OAA SHUTDOWN_REQUEST/RESPONSE. Wire ids agree.
discrepancies.resolution: Naming only.

discrepancies.summary: Optional-field canonicalization divergence on PingResponse (same pattern applies to PingRequest.f2/f3): for the value {timestamp=42, data empty} our encoder emits proto2 present-but-empty f2 (body 08 2A 12 00) where the canonical minimal encoding is 08 2A (f2 absent). Both forms are wire-legal and decode identically through our codec, but the bytes differ from a minimal-speaking peer or an exact-byte harness.
oaa: oaa/control/ControlMessageIdsEnum.proto:24 (id) + oaa/control/PingResponseMessage.proto:21-22 (dedicated OAA schema: `required int64 timestamp = 1; optional bytes payload = 2`)
third_party/aasdk/protobuf/aap_protobuf/service/control/message/PingResponse.proto:5-8 (pinned AASDK: `required int64 timestamp = 1; optional bytes data = 2`)
proto2 wire rule: absent optional fields are not serialized
ours: src/protocol/aasdk_adapter/ControlAdapter.cpp:146-154 (set_data(copy_string(data)) marks f2 present even when empty)
discrepancies.resolution: Fixture F-J pins the spec-minimal form; F-J2 pins the current encoder form; both decode-asserted and the divergence is EXPECT_NE-pinned. Canonical-encode fix (omit defaulted/empty optional fields on encode) would change accepted task-15 encoder bytes -> PROPOSED, not implemented; needs an explicit reviewed decision since a peer exact-byte harness may compare against either form.

coverage.included: control handshake (version, SDP, channel open/close, ping), nav/audio focus ids, AV setup/start/stop/ack, video focus, UI config 0x8009/0x800A/0x8011/0x8012, underflow, media stats/options ids, frame header/flags, ID-space model - i.e. everything tasks 28-33 need plus the known discrepancy anchors
coverage.excluded_rows: radio (0x801A-0x8023), car-control (0x8001-0x8007 on ch 19), car-intent, mediabrowser (dead 16.1+), sensor/bt/wifi message bodies, mic AV input open pair bodies - wire IDs noted where they collide with audited spaces; bodies audited when tasks 35-38 (wireless bootstrap) start

method.derivation: Every row was checked against BOTH the OAA rulebook (commit-pinned) and the pinned AASDK schema or project source. Where OAA contradicts itself, the ranking used is: 17.3 endpoint message-matrix (confirmed-static) > gold/silver proto comments with APK/live-capture evidence > cross-version correction tables > channel docs > interaction docs. Known OAA-internal defects are flagged (D18, D19, D20).
method.fixture_linkage: fixture_ref names the independent raw-byte fixtures in tests/replay/conformance_wire_spec.hpp (branch aa/pre28-conformance-audit); fixture files in tests/replay/fixtures/conformance/ use the task-20 aa-replay-fixture-v1 envelope with SHA-256 pinning.
